title: Kissed Smoky Greek Brussels Sprouts Revithia
description: A sweet and crunchy Greek dish featuring Brussels sprouts, perfect for a date night, with a smoky flavor and raw-friendly ingredients in the form of revithia.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the Brussels sprouts with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the Brussels sprouts in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the Brussels sprouts are roasting, whisk together the lemon juice and honey in a small bowl.
After the Brussels sprouts have roasted for 20 minutes, remove them from the oven and brush them with the lemon juice and honey mixture.
Return the Brussels sprouts to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until they are tender and caramelized.
Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Serve the Brussels sprouts hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
